activity.notes: After the 11 November 1965 UDI, Smith led the de facto Rhodesian state, which lacked broad international recognition. This activity ends on 1 June 1979 when the Zimbabwe Rhodesia government took office.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1964–1968, Volume XXIV, Africa, doc. 553 — U.S. Department of State
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State records Winston Field's replacement by Ian Smith as prime minister in April 1964 and Smith's unilateral break with the British Crown on 11 November 1965.

sources.title: Black Government Takes Power in Salisbury — The Washington Post, 1 June 1979
sources.citation_text: The report identifies Ian Smith as the outgoing prime minister when the Zimbabwe Rhodesia government took office on 1 June 1979.
